verses.text: Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayik ol ex k'och t'a lum lum ol wak' t'ayex yik tzex kajnaj t'ay,

tato ayex tze nhustz'a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa silab'il, mato yik tze k'anab'ajan b'aj tzeyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma tonhej tz'el t'a he k'o'ol, ma yuj junok k'inh yuj chi' tzeyak'a', yowalil tzeyak'pax chab'ok libra harina te wach' kalab'il yet' junok litro aceite yet' silab' chi'. Ha jun silab' chi' te suk'uk'i sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik.
Ha yet' juntzanh silab' toxo ix wal chi' tzeyak' junok litro wino ofrenda'il yet' junjun nok' kalnel chi'.
Tato a junok nok' ch'ak kalnel tzeyak' silab'il, tzeyak'pax wajxake'ok libra harina skalaj yet' junok litro aceite yet' jab'okxo,
ek'topax jun litro wino tzeyak' yet'ok. Te suk'uk'i sjab' jun ofrenda chi' swab'i.
Tato a junok nok' kelem wakax tzeyak' silab'il to stz'a'i, ma silab'il yik tze k'anab'ajej b'aj tzeyak' he ti', ma silab'il yik junk'olal,
tzeyak'pax lajchawe'ok libra harina, chab'ok litro aceite
yet' pax chab'ok litro wino ofrenda'il yet'ok. Ha jun ofrenda chi' suk'uk'i sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik.
Haton juntzanh tik yowalil tzeyak' yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', ma yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel, ma yet' junjun nok' yunetak kalnel, ma yet' junjun nok' yunetak chiwa.
Icha sb'isul nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', icha pax chi' sb'isul juntzanhxo ofrenda chi' tzeyak' yet'ok.
E masanil a ex israel ex tik, yowalil tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh ley tik smasanil ayik tze nhusantz'a eyofrenda suk'uk'i sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik.

Tato ay junok ch'ok chonhab'il tonhej sb'eyek' t'a he kal, mato kajan heyet'ok, tato snib'ej snhusantz'a junok silab' to suk'uk'i sjab' swab'i, yowalil sk'anab'ajej masanil sleyal icha tze k'anab'ajej a ex tik.

Ha jun ley chi' tz'och yopisio eyu'uj yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan eyet' chi'. Ha jun ley chi' ol b'eynhejb'at t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ex tik yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, lajan eyelk'och t'a yol in sat a in Jehová in tik.
Junnhej ley heyik yaj yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik smasanil t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayik kajanexxo ek' t'a lum b'aj ol ex wik'b'ati,
a ixim trigo syak' t'a lum lum chi' ol he wa'a, yowalil tzeyik'kanel jab'ok ixim t'a ofrenda'il yik tzeyak' t'ayin,
icha tz'aj yak'chaj ixim sb'ab'laj tek'ji'eli, icha chi' tz'aj eyak'an ixim t'ayin. Hanhejtona' tzeyak'pax jun b'ab'el pan sb'o t'a ixim harina yik ixim ak' trigo chi' ofrenda'il t'ayin.
Ha jun makan ofrenda chi' ol eyak'nhej t'ayin a in Jehová in tik t'a masanil tiempo.
Talaj sb'at satk'olal eyuj he k'ulan junok cheknab'il ix wal t'a winhaj Moisés tik t'a sb'ab'elal,
yuj chi' maxtzak he k'anab'ajej yet' pax heb' eyinhtilal ayik ol b'eynhejb'atok, haton tik ol he k'ulej:

Tato ay junok cheknab'il sb'at satk'olal eyuj he k'ulan he masanil, yowalil snhusjitz'a junok nok' kelem wakax eyuj he masanil t'a silab'il to suk'uk'i sjab' swab' a in Jehová in tik yet' ixim trigo yet' wino tzeyak'taxon ofrenda'il yet' silab' chi', icha t'a sleyal. Tzeyak'an junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj yak'ji tup he mul.

Haxo junok winh sacerdote sb'o'an jun chi' eyuj he masanil ichataxon t'a sleyal yik stupkanel he mul t'a eyib'anh. Ha in ton swak' tupel he mul chi' yujto manh sk'anok he k'o'ol tze k'ulani, yujto ix eyak'pax silab' yuj he mul.
Ha yuj he silab' chi', stupkanel he mul chi' t'a eyib'anh a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, yujto he masanil ix och he mul.
Palta tato junnhej anima tz'och smul, yuj sb'at satk'olal yuj sk'anab'ajan junok cheknab'il, a yuj smul chi', yowalil syak' junok nok' kob'es chiwa jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il.
Haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'anoch jun silab' chi' t'a wichanh ichataxon t'a sleyal yuj smul jun anima ix och chi', ayik toxo ix ak'chaj jun silab' chi', stupkanel smul jun anima chi' t'a yib'anh.
Hanheja' jun ley chi' tz'och yopisio eyu'uj yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, ayik tz'och he mul to manh sk'anok he k'o'ol.

Palta tato ay mach tz'och smul to sk'an sk'o'ol, wach'chom eyetchonhab', ma junok ch'ok chonhab'il, a t'ayin Jehová in tik tz'och smul yuj spitalil. Yuj chi' manhxa'okab' yalan yik jun anima chi' t'a he kal.
Yujto ix spatikejel in lolonel, ix stenanek' in cheknab'il, yuj chi' manhxa'okab' yalan yik t'a he kal t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ayek' heb' israel t'a tzinan lu'um, ay jun winh israel chi' wan yek' k'atzitz t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip ix yilan heb'.
Ix ik'jib'at winh t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés, t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' yuj heb' ix ilan chi'.
Ix tanhwaj winh yuj heb' yujto manto chekelok tas ol utaj winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh tik yowalil ol cham winh. Masanil heb' chonhab' tik sjulk'enan winh t'a spatikel campamento, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yik'el winh heb' t'a spatikel campamento chi'. Hata' ix sjulk'enejcham winh heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha ex tik yet' heb' eyinhtilal, yowalilokab' tz'och yelwanub' stitak he pichul. Ha juntzanh yelwanub' tz'och chi', a anh ch'al tzek'b'il topan, stz'ischajoch t'a he pichul chi' yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak.

Ayik ol eyilanoch juntzanh yelwanub' chi', ol he na'ankot masanil cheknab'il ix wala' to yowalil tze k'anab'ajej, yik wach' manh ol ex kuchb'ajb'at t'a juntzanh tas malaj swach'il yuj he pensar, ma yuj tas he gana t'a yol eyiko'.
Icha wal chi' ol aj he na'ankot in cheknab'il, ol he k'anab'ajani. Icha chi' ol aj eyak'anoch he b'a t'ayin to wik ex, a in he Diosal in.
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yik tzin och he Diosalok, yuj chi' swal juntzanh tik t'ayex, xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
